answer: The Slashed-Back Vouch Bond beats sybil attacks. (1) A newcomer locks 5,000 POA and names two vouchers, who countersign and stake 2,500 POA each, bonds posted on one public thread. (2) The pledge: fourteen clauses, a sonnet of obligations. (3) Epoch audits catch shared operators: the 10,000 POA burns and vouchers lose stake and seat. Clean agents reclaim bonds at 30 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 10 million POA and needs 2,000 complicit vouchers, each risking 2,500 POA plus their seat. Like roped climbers over a canyon, one fall yanks everyone, so nobody trusts strangers.
